Agent Island v0.11.3 separates Codex's short-term and weekly quota windows so you can see which limit actually needs attention.

### What's new

- Shows the Codex 5-hour and weekly remaining percentages side by side in hover and workspace views.
- Displays the reset time for each quota window in the usage tooltip.
- Preserves the previous single-window display when only one readable quota is available.
- Includes both normalized quota windows in the loopback-only `/v1/state` snapshot for local integrations.

### Privacy

- Both quota windows are read only from local Codex `token_count` records and held in process memory.
- The local `/v1/state` endpoint includes the quota snapshot. It binds to `127.0.0.1`, but other programs running as the same Windows user may still call a loopback service.
- No new outbound network request, telemetry, analytics, or cloud account was added.
- Prompt text remains visible by default; reasoning content is not read.

### Windows download notice

The portable x64 build is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen may show an “Unknown publisher” warning. Verify the accompanying `.sha256` file before running the executable, or build from source.

Please report bugs in Issues and share quota-display feedback in Discussions. Do not post private prompts, clipboard contents, notification text, tokens, account details, Credits balances, or local paths.
